claims.claim: Crew-13 docked with the ISS 7 hours and 55 minutes after liftoff.
claims.episode_span: The Dragon capsule docked at the Harmony forward port 7 hours and 55 minutes after liftoff.
claims.source_title: The SpaceX crew set a record by reaching the ISS in less than 8 hours
claims.supporting_quote: Seven hours and 55 minutes later, the SpaceX Dragon "Grace" capsule docked with an ISS port, setting a record for the fastest flight by an American spacecraft to the station.

claims.claim: Rheinmetall and Argotec satellite launched October 1 on Falcon 9 from Vandenberg.
claims.episode_span: The satellite launched October 1 on a Falcon 9 from Vandenberg and will detect ground indicators of airborne threats.
claims.source_title: Rheinmetall and Argotec launch their first satellite into space with SpaceX
claims.supporting_quote: On October 1, 2026, the first satellite developed within this collaboration was successfully launched into orbit aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 launch vehicle from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California, United States.
